\caption[C-Fair Favorite and ReverseFavorite Attacks on age against fairness-aware MF-based recommenders]{C-Fair Favorite and ReverseFavorite Attacks on age against fairness-aware MF-based recommenders. The benefit ratio $\gamma$ per model is shown across attack strategies, datasets, and attack budgets. The conventional MF counterpart is included for comparison. \textsc{PushR} and \textsc{PushLF} are shown in their \textsc{Favorite} variant and \textsc{NukeF} in its \textsc{ReverseFavorite} variant.
For readability, values above $1.3$ are clipped (in ML100K).}
